page.content:
Modern women's world title from the four-horsewomen era onward.

How WWE Women's Championship connects

  • Character: Becky Lynch — Becky Lynch's The Man run was built on the WWE Women's Championship.
  • Character: Rhea Ripley — Rhea Ripley held the women's world title as Judgment Day's Mami.

What is WWE Women's Championship?

The WWE Women's Championship (in its post-2016 form) is the top women's prize Becky Lynch, Rhea Ripley, and others have held across Raw and SmackDown brand splits.

Key threads lead to Becky Lynch and Rhea Ripley.
